关键词: China Venture Capital Fund Corporation Limited
主要内容: On September 13, 2017, the U.S. Treasury Secretary, Steven T. Mnuchin, issued a statement regarding the President’s decision to prohibit the acquisition of Lattice Semiconductor Corporation by Canyon Bridge Fund I, LP (CBFI), its subsidiaries, Yitai Capital Limited (Yitai), and Yitai’s parent company, China Venture Capital Fund Corporation Limited (CVCF). The President’s order, based on Section 721 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended by the Foreign Investment and National Security Act of 2007, aims to protect U.S. national security by preventing the transfer of intellectual property and ensuring the integrity of the semiconductor supply chain. Lattice, a publicly traded semiconductor company based in Oregon, produces programmable logic devices for consumer, communications, and industrial markets. The decision was influenced by CFIUS’s assessment that the transaction posed a risk to U.S. national security that could not be mitigated. The U.S. Department of the Treasury issued a statement regarding the President’s decision on Lattice Semiconductor Corporation. CFIUS, an interagency committee, reviews transactions that could result in foreign control of a U.S. business to assess national security impacts. The analysis considered all relevant national security factors under Section 721 and received input from the Office of the Director of National Intelligence. The CFIUS process focuses on identifying and addressing national security concerns while maintaining an open investment policy. The committee is chaired by the Secretary of the Treasury and includes members from various federal agencies, with the Director of National Intelligence and the Secretary of Labor participating as non-voting members.

股票实体.名称: China Venture Capital Fund Corporation Limited
